selection: mean frozen-inner-fold AP of the three-seed mean probability; tie first configuration
gate_loss: unweighted BCE on calibrated branch logits; no final intercept, calibrator or action bypass
concat_loss: training-class-balanced BCE; sigmoid calibrator on selected inner OOF logits only
threshold: selected inner OOF mean probabilities; balanced accuracy grid .01..99, tie nearest .5

decision.multiplicity: seven required paired contrasts: marginal 95% intervals reported; adaptive claims additionally require simultaneous Bonferroni percentile lower AP bound >0 across the three adaptive-vs-F2 comparisons
decision.prefer_simple: No adaptive value claim from point rank alone. E if no adaptive qualifies and all adaptive AP upper95<=.01; otherwise A with uncertainty stated. B/C/D according to qualifying mechanism, prefer F4/F5 unless F6 also improves by >=.01 over qualifying simpler gate with positive paired AP interval and AUROC lower>-.01. F if reused F2 fails numerical/metric parity.

ablation: one fixed seeded action permutation within each test fold; zero action; quality training mean after training-only standardization; masks unchanged
interpretation: Adaptive exploratory same-cohort study, not independent confirmation. SQ3 NOT YET ANSWERED.
quality_missing: Unavailable audited values imputed to current fitting-subset means (zero after scaling); no extra missing indicators or label-based exclusion
